Reasoning: The release stage keeps the current panda_fingertip pose fixed while opening the gripper. freeze_position holds the fingertip origin at the pose inherited from the immediately preceding placement stage within 0.01 m. freeze_orientation holds the inherited fingertip orientation within 0.05 rad and does not add any new tool +z or +y alignment constraint. open_gripper commands the fingers to the fully open/released state; its condition also includes manipulator_low_effort to represent the required drop toward free-space contact/effort feedback as far as the available labels permit. The API has no negative/not-grasped operator, so explicit confirmation that cube_3 is no longer grasped cannot be represented directly. The cube_3-on-cube_2, cube_2-on-cube_1, and cube_1-undisturbed pose-monitoring requirements are also not encoded because the API allows at most one position operator in the stage and does not provide a monitoring-only or arbitrary-object pose-hold operator for non-gripped objects.
